title: Freezing a relatively continuous weight in blow-up integrals under a bounded density ratio
statement: Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ and Hⁿ := μHE[n] on ℝ^{n+ℓ}. Let C ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} be Borel with Hⁿ(C) < ∞, ϑ : ℝ^{n+ℓ} → ℝ any function, and x ∈ ℝ^{n+ℓ} such that ϑ is continuous at x relative to C (ContinuousWithinAt ϑ C x). Suppose that for every R > 0 there is Λ ∈ ℝ with (rⁿ)⁻¹·Hⁿ(C ∩ B_{rR}(x)) ≤ Λ eventually as r ↓ 0, where the measure is taken as a real number and B is the closed ball. Then for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^{n+ℓ}, ℝ), (rⁿ)⁻¹·∫_C f(η_{x,r}(z))·(ϑ(z) − ϑ(x)) dHⁿ(z) → 0 as r ↓ 0, where η_{x,r} = Chapter03.blowUpMap x r.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (C : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (ϑ : Amb n ℓ → ℝ) (x : Amb n ℓ), MeasurableSet C → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) C < ∞ → ContinuousWithinAt ϑ C x → (∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → ∃ Λ : ℝ, ∀ᶠ r in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), (r ^ n)⁻¹ * (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)).real (C ∩ closedBall x (r * R)) ≤ Λ) → ∀ f : CompactlySupportedContinuousMap (Amb n ℓ) ℝ, Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => (r ^ n)⁻¹ * ∫ z in C, f (Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap x r z) * (ϑ z - ϑ x) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
